notes: Closing tagent no longer closes the conversation: boot replays the last chat under the banner, and /clear [count|all] wipes only the text on screen while the agent’s memory stays. Every running sync engine heartbeats into the repo, so the navbar shows when another device is online; /repo status grows a per-project sync history. The agent can now budget each MCP call itself with __timeout_ms, and same-millisecond sessions no longer confuse the boot-resume picker.
